> Flag any notable quotes, statistics, or unique insights from the text by placing them directly under the relevant subsection.

> Do not invent, fabricate, or extrapolate information outside of the provided text.

> Source Material:
> [PASTE YOUR RAW NOTES, TRANSCRIPT, OR SOURCE TEXT HERE]
